description: The file defines external function declarations for timed wait operations using pthread condition variables and mutexes, focusing on timed waits with different granularity and timeout specifications.

methods.name: initTimedWaitCond
methods.description: Initializes a pthread condition variable for timed wait usage.

methods.name: incrementalCondTimedWait
methods.description: Performs a timed wait on a condition variable using the monotonic clock for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: incrementalCondTimedWaitMillis
methods.description: Performs a timed wait on a condition variable using the monotonic clock with millisecond granularity.

methods.name: granularIncrementalCondTimedWait
methods.description: Performs a more granular timed wait using a timespec structure for nanosecond precision.
